segments.text:
V. 44.
Whoſoever ſhall fall on this ſtone ſhall be broken—Stumbles at Chriſt, ſhall even then receive much Hurt. He is ſaid to fall on this Stone, who hears the Goſpel, and does not believe. But on whomſoever it ſhall fall— In Vengeance, it will utterly deſtroy him. It will fall on every Unbeliever, when Chriſt cometh in the Clouds of Heaven.
